metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a dinner that kept the parlour back, a bill read, and the lovers a second time.

yesterday: You did not tell the parlour at dinner. The loaf was two fingers short, at a penny.
Longshanks is the Rose's title. You read it.
The prologue was the same line. The yard was nearly as full as Saturday.
Nick was under the note. The book of Saturday stood, with Monday's mark in it.
